purpose: Read-only diagnosis of recoverable generated artifacts on the nearly full macOS system volume.
scope: No files were deleted or moved. No full-volume scan, test, build, browser session, or app restart was performed.

candidates.evidence: Four pnpm dlx temporary installs; largest is shadcn@3.8.5 at 101 MiB, with files dated Feb 20 2026. No pnpm/npm/yarn/bun process was present and lsof found no open references beneath this directory.
candidates.assessment: Strongest safe/recoverable candidate for modest headroom. It is package-manager-owned temporary execution state and can be recreated by rerunning the package command; cleanup should use the package manager's supported mechanism. No cleanup was performed.

candidates.evidence: Contains a 684 MiB downloaded update archive dated Oct 7 12:26 and its 1.6 GiB expanded ChatGPT.app build 26.1002.52244/13536. Installed app reports 26.930.61225/13232. Sparkle Autoupdate and Updater processes (PIDs 36891 and 36892) have been alive since Oct 7 12:26; ChatGPT itself is running. The updater currently has no archive/staging file open according to lsof.
candidates.assessment: Not safe to clean while ChatGPT and its updater are running: this is a pending staged app update, despite the absence of current open file handles. Reassess only after the update lifecycle completes and the updater exits.

candidates.evidence: Playwright Chromium test-browser payload. No Playwright/Chromium test process was present, but NotificationCenter (PID 1053) has an open executable-resource file from this app bundle.
candidates.assessment: Re-downloadable test runtime, but not a safe immediate cleanup candidate because a system process still has a file open. It is a browser binary cache, not a browser profile; left untouched.

candidates.evidence: Codex runtime cache; Codex desktop and code-mode processes are active. No per-runtime ownership/idle proof was established.
candidates.assessment: Unknown and excluded because it may back active Codex sessions.
Excluded. This is unrelated system/user state and was not inspected or targeted.

repository_context: matrx-extend node_modules is 1.4 GiB on the external Samsung2TB volume, so removing it would not recover system-volume space.
conclusion: The 111 MiB inactive pnpm dlx cache is the only presently well-supported small cleanup candidate. The much larger Sparkle stage is tied to a live update, and the other large caches lack sufficient safe-disposal evidence.
